content.title: Audio-Interface Type | Waveform, Route, Portrait and Sync Lockup
content.summary: An adult sound editor drives waveform, control, route and portrait modules into a SYNC lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult identity and at least four appearance anchors precede every interface module. + Each module is triggered by one visible body or headphone action and introduces no more than one exact short word. + Waveform, control ring, play bar and fragments remain one coherent graphic system. + Boot and portrait-grid proofs verify the same character before the terminal movement. + The final lockup reunites the adult, settled fragments, recurring rings and one readable original master mark.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open one original cream media panel that types the exact word "SYNC", then reveal an original clearly adult sound editor with a cobalt braid, amber headphones, graphite jacket and one mint waveform patch. One forward run crosses the outlined word "FLOW" and hands directly into a controlled slide along a navy play bar; no extra character or wardrobe appears. The adult walks through the settled fragments and stops inside concentric rings carrying the exact full mark "SYNC / KEEP THE BEAT"; hold every word readable.
required_anchors: One clearly adult identity and at least four appearance anchors precede every interface module.
Each module is triggered by one visible body or headphone action and introduces no more than one exact short word.
Boot and portrait-grid proofs verify the same character before the terminal movement.
The final lockup reunites the adult, settled fragments, recurring rings and one readable original master mark.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult sound editor drives waveform, control, route and portrait modules into a SYNC lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 同一成年动画角色以薄荷双发髻、橙色耳机和藏蓝橙夹克保持身份；播放界面、波形、音量环、下落字、跑跳、编号肖像和圆环破碎按动作分章，最后人物站在完整原创播放主标前。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult identity and at least four appearance anchors precede every interface module.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult identity and at least four appearance anchors precede every interface module."

invariants.rule: Each module is triggered by one visible body or headphone action and introduces no more than one exact short word.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each module is triggered by one visible body or headphone action and introduces no more than one exact short word."

invariants.rule: Waveform, control ring, play bar and fragments remain one coherent graphic system.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Waveform, control ring, play bar and fragments remain one coherent graphic system."

invariants.rule: Boot and portrait-grid proofs verify the same character before the terminal movement.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Boot and portrait-grid proofs verify the same character before the terminal movement."

invariants.rule: The final lockup reunites the adult, settled fragments, recurring rings and one readable original master mark.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final lockup reunites the adult, settled fragments, recurring rings and one readable original master mark."

slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
